pr_title: usb: hid: allow boot interface Protocol Code to be set per device
pr_body:
Kconfig option USB_HID_PROTOCOL_CODE does not allow to set
boot interface protocol code for specific HID device but
only to set the same value for all device.
Add new API function to allow the application to set
Protocol Code per device. Deprecate USB_HID_PROTOCOL_CODE option.

Fixes: #32778

issue_context.title: Cannot support both HID boot report keyboard and mouse on a USB HID device
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
With current Zephyr implementation, the USB HID instances share a single HID boot report type (set as a Kconfig option). If we add support for defining the HID boot report type separately for every USB HID instance, we could send boot reports as both mouse and keyboard to the host computer in boot report mode.

**Expected behavior**
USB HID device with multiple HID instances should be able to forward HID boot reports both as mouse and keyboard.

**Impact**
Cannot design USB HID device that supports HID boot reports from both mouse and keyboard.

**Environment**
 - Commit SHA: 48321ef2525c14c4d9b6040afe8ae72ff07a8d1e

review_comments: Protocol codes from range 3-255 are marked as reserved in specification, should we return an error code if user tries to set them ?
I think no, reserved may be still valid.
